summary: Assess spatial accuracy, completeness and uncertainty with practical geospatial QA methods. Explore the course and strengthen your validation workflow.
lede: Geospatial data quality training helps GIS managers, remote-sensing analysts and mapping teams judge whether spatial datasets are reliable for a specific decision. Participants practise testing positional accuracy, completeness and thematic accuracy; interpreting samples and error matrices; and recording metadata and uncertainty. They also develop repeatable QA checks and review automated geometry checks and AI-derived classifications at an operational or conceptual level, without coding or production model development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who validate, manage or rely on geospatial datasets in operational decisions. It is suitable for those with basic GIS or spatial-data familiarity who need a structured quality-assurance approach.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with GIS concepts, spatial datasets and map-based workflows is expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to complete the spreadsheet-based calculations; familiarity with basic spreadsheet formulas is helpful.
